title: scaffold collab-ready: .github/ (CI, dependabot, PR template, optional CODEOWNERS)
description: Extend scaffold so a fresh repo is collaboration-ready: .github/ with the existing CI plus dependabot.yml (grouped updates, weekly), a PR template, and optional CODEOWNERS. Self-contained, directly serves the 'repo always ready' goal. Candidate first atomic unit.
design:
DESIGN (approved 2026-06-02) — scaffold collab-ready.

GATING: single lever. Rename --no-ci -> --no-github (NO_CI->NO_GITHUB, WANT_CI->
WANT_GITHUB). CI becomes one component of "GitHub hygiene". Default-on in data/python,
off in minimal and via --no-github. No separate dependabot/template gate (no real
"CI yes, dependabot no" case; cheap to split later if it appears).

INVARIANT (load-bearing): WANT_GITHUB ⇒ WANT_PY today, because minimal is the only
no-Python profile and it also disables github. This lets the new templates be STATIC
(no conditional uv-ecosystem render). Anchored with a comment AND a loud runtime guard
in scaffold.sh: if WANT_GITHUB && ! WANT_PY, error out — so a future github-without-
Python profile fails noisily, not silently emitting a broken dependabot.yml.

NEW STATIC TEMPLATES (emitted under WANT_GITHUB):
- templates/dependabot.yml -> .github/dependabot.yml: version 2; two grouped weekly
  updates — github-actions (CI uses checkout+setup-uv) and uv (native ecosystem,
  verified supported). groups patterns ["*"].
- templates/pull_request_template.md -> .github/pull_request_template.md: Summary /
  Changes / Testing / Related (link the bead).
- templates/CODEOWNERS -> .github/CODEOWNERS: commented placeholder, English, no
  handle, no flag. Explains when to uncomment + why a live rule blocks merges on a
  solo-dev repo. Travels with --no-github.

WIRING: scaffold.sh section 7 renamed "GitHub collaboration hygiene"; under WANT_GITHUB
emits ci.yml + test_smoke.py (existing) PLUS the three new files.

COMMITS (single branch feat/5q6.2-collab-ready-scaffold, two intentions):
1. refactor: rename the lever, no behavior change (scaffold.sh + README + CLAUDE.md +
   memory note).
2. feat: invariant guard + the three templates + wiring + doc updates for the new files.

VERIFY: bash -n, shellcheck, dry-run; real scaffold to /tmp — 3 new files + ci.yml
present in data, ABSENT in minimal and with --no-github; YAML of dependabot.yml parses.
notes: Implemented on branch feat/5q6.2-collab-ready-scaffold. Commits: 47fd504 (refactor: rename --no-ci->--no-github, no behavior change) + 964a15b (feat: dependabot.yml, pull_request_template.md, CODEOWNERS + wiring + loud invariant guard). Verified: bash -n; gating correct in data (5 files) / minimal (none) / --no-github (none) via dry-run; dependabot.yml valid YAML (ecosystems github-actions + uv). Pending: integration (merge/PR) + push.
close_reason: Merged to main (local) via --no-ff: 47fd504 refactor + 964a15b feat. Verified: bash -n, gating data/minimal/--no-github, dependabot.yml valid YAML.

title: Decision: plugin topology — one plugin or two?
description: scaffold + research-setup are creation/evaluation tools; project-start + project-commit + project-pr are a daily-flow toolset — different axes/cadence. Decide: keep everything in project-kit, or split the daily-flow commands into a second plugin. This decision shapes where the three /project-* commands live, so it BLOCKS them.
design:
ADR — Plugin topology: ONE plugin, commands grouped by prefix convention.

DECISION: a single plugin (project-kit). Commands grouped by a prefix naming
convention:
  creation/eval : /project-scaffold, /project-research
  daily flow    : /project-start, /project-commit, /project-pr

CONTEXT: scaffold+research (creation) and start+commit+pr (daily flow) feel like
distinct axes, but they are NOT independent: the flow CONSUMES the substrate that
scaffold creates. /project-start reads `bd ready`, which exists only because
scaffold ran `bd init`. This is one layered system with a single consumer, not
two parallel plugins.

WHY NOT TWO NOW: the choice is reversible and cheap both ways — splitting or
merging later is trivial. Deciding topology before the flow commands exist would
be organizing architecture around code that isn't written yet.

HOW COHESION IS EARNED WITHOUT SPLITTING: the /project- prefix communicates the
group. It also resolves the /scaffold collision (ae8), so 5q6.1 and ae8 close
together.

SPLIT TRIGGER (auditable): split into two plugins when scaffold gains a consumer
distinct from the daily flow — e.g. sharing the templates with someone who uses
their own workflow, or publishing scaffold standalone. Until then: one plugin.
notes: Resolves ae8: the /project- prefix rename (/scaffold->/project-scaffold, /research-setup->/project-research) is the collision fix.
close_reason: ADR recorded: one plugin, /project- prefix convention. Unblocks .4/.5/.6.

title: v0.2 — single-intention git flow & collab-ready scaffolding
description: Umbrella for the v0.2 design session. Real problem to solve: the diff should NEVER need to be untangled later. Two prongs: (a) daily-flow commands that enforce one intention per branch and incremental, reviewable commits; (b) scaffold output that is collaboration-ready out of the box (CI, dependabot, PR template). EXPLICITLY OUT OF SCOPE for now: Graphite / stacked PRs.
design:
DESIGN (2026-10-03) — daily flow: start → commit → pr

Same shape as scaffold: a skill per command drives a deterministic script in scripts/
(so ShellCheck in CI covers the logic). Skill dirs follow the ADR in 5q6.1:
skills/project-start, skills/project-commit, skills/project-pr.

Shared state lives in git, not in new files: start-branch.sh records the intention and the bead
in `git config branch.<name>.description` and `branch.<name>.bead`. pr-body.sh reads both.

- scripts/start-branch.sh <bead-id> [--type T] [--title S] [--worktree [DIR]] [--base REF] [--dry-run]
  branch <type>/<bead-id>-<slug>; type from the bead (feature→feat, bug→fix, chore/task→chore,
  decision→spike; epic refused), overridable. Branches from origin/<default>, refuses an existing
  branch or a dirty tree, claims the bead.
- scripts/commit-check.sh [--message MSG]: checks the STAGED diff. Blocking: nothing staged,
  `git diff --cached --check`, likely secrets (added lines + key/env filenames), files over
  PK_MAX_FILE_KB (default 5120), and a non-Conventional header or one over 72 chars. Warning: AI
  metadata in added lines (repo policy decides). The skill proposes the message and WAITS.
- scripts/pr-body.sh [--base REF]: body in the shape of templates/pull_request_template.md.
  Summary = branch intention (or the single commit subject), Changes = commit subjects,
  Testing = left for the agent to fill with what was actually run, Related = `bd: <id>`.
  The skill sets a Conventional title (squash-merge makes it the commit on main), shows title
  and body, WAITS, then `gh pr create` (REST `gh api .../pulls` fallback when GraphQL is blocked).

Out of scope: stacked PRs, renaming scaffold/research-setup (own bead), auto-push from commit.

design: DECISION PENDING — pointer target. Repo is now PUBLIC and scaffolded repos do NOT have project-kit checked out locally, so a local repo path would be a dangling reference for the user. Leaning to the public URL (https://github.com/R0SEWT/project-kit/blob/main/SETUP-CHECKLIST.md) rather than a local path. Decide format at implementation time, in its own session. title: fix scaffold.sh tr ranges: POSIX char classes (SC2018/SC2019)
description: ShellCheck (the lint CI job) fails on scripts/scaffold.sh:57 — 'tr A-Z a-z' is flagged SC2019/SC2018 (use [:upper:]/[:lower:] to support accents). Pre-existing since 964a15b (the 5q6.2 scaffold feat), surfaced by the repo's first PR (#1, the 5q6.3 doc). The action exits 1 on any finding incl. note-severity, so main is red and every PR inherits it. Fix: tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]'. Unblocks merging PR #1.

close_reason: Absorbed by 5q6.1: the /project- prefix convention (rename to /project-scaffold + /project-research) is the collision resolution.

title: /project-pr — gh pr create with body derived from commits

description: Create a well-named branch from a bead: name pattern <feat|fix|docs|ci|chore|spike>/<bead-id>-<slug>. Optional git worktree. Declares the scope of ONE intention up front. Blocked by the plugin-topology decision.

title: /project-commit — incremental Conventional-Commit checkpoint, propose-and-wait
description: Incremental commit checkpoint: Conventional Commits message, runs git diff --check, detects secrets / large files / AI metadata. PROPOSES the commit and WAITS for approval — does not commit directly. Core of the 'diff never needs untangling' goal. Blocked by the plugin-topology decision.

Renaming changes how users invoke them, so in 0.x it is an incompatible change (MINOR bump) with a compatibility note. Kept out of the daily-flow release on purpose.
